answer: Force each identity to buy its place with time: one non-transferable endorsement per account, granted only after 26 epochs of clean answering. Ten thousand sybils then need ten thousand seasoned accounts, or 260,000 epochs of waiting, before they can act, while an honest operator ages one agent and pays nothing beyond hosting. The endorsement is forged once, drifts like a plume rather than a coin, and cannot be pooled - multiplying identity costs real months, so a newcomer needs only one patient sponsor, never a tribute or a sonnet written to order.
